Well this game was definitely better than Split Fiction. It had a cringe start but it had a better ending. The one thing we absolutely couldn't stand was that damn book. He was so extra and annoying. And spoilers ahead, but the elephant was too much. We genuinely had to pause for a minute and process what just happened. You couldn't have made her a boss fight, no no we had to kill the innocent creature that begged and pleaded for her life as we tore her apart. Fuck that. And then there's the levels themselves. In some, they were well thought out with simple puzzles that were in enjoyable, others felt like a bunch of mechanics lumped together and called a "level". My friend and I were really going through the levels quickly at the end, simply just because wanted it to be over. You can definitely tell this game is EA. It's good, but there's changes that should have been made. Overall, 8/10 game.

I played this game with my partner. We have a very healthy and strong relationship. We both cried at the end. Absolutely beautiful with funny and corny moments. Huge thanks to the devs for not only giving us an experience we became even closer from, but also a tagline we'll use forever - It Took Two <3

The game play itself is amazing. My husband and I love it. Unique puzzles and co-op timing required. The couple and storyline will annoy you if you know anything about relationships and/or parenting. You will want to divorce them while playing. Their constant bickering never changes. However, the gameplay is worth muting the game and turning on the music and just figuring out the puzzles for yourself.  The worlds changing and the one-of-a-kind atmospheres and areas you are put in are beautiful, the characters enchanting, and just challenging enough to keep you on your toes.  We've been gaming for 20 years together and we've not seen a game like this before.    Gameplay 10/10.
Its a nice game to develop collaborative skills and team building with friends and family.
